profile.headline: Software Engineer 1 at Monarch Quantum
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer and Mathematics student at UC San Diego with a proven track record in fullstack development. Currently advancing biometric technology at Synolo Biometrics while building Impartial Search, a proxy search engine. Previously broadened marketing reach at Green Man Gaming through Discord integration. Passionate about performance optimization, machine learning, and creating innovative solutions across multiple programming languages and cloud platforms. Open to new opportunities in software engineering and mathematical computing.
